categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in immune gene engineering, non-gene modified cell therapy products, and non-cell products. Its core focus is on developing CAR-T cell therapies, especially for B-cell lymphoma (PL001), alongside non-gene modified cell therapies such as CIK, DC-CIK, and ADSC for cancer and degenerative diseases. Additionally, it produces a hair growth liquid product.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary CAR-T cell technology, including single-chain and multi-chain CAR designs, with viral transduction methods using patented lentiviral packaging systems. It develops and optimizes upstream and downstream lentivirus production processes and employs GMP-compliant manufacturing facilities. The company also develops allogeneic (off-the-shelf) CAR-T platforms and peptide drugs synthesized chemically.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major medical institutions and hospitals in Taiwan, such as Chung Shan Medical University Hospital and others, for cell therapy product manufacturing and clinical treatments. The primary market is domestic Taiwan, focusing on cancer patients and degenerative disease sufferers. The company also targets international markets including the US, Japan, and Singapore for regulatory approvals and future sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are concentrated in Taiwan, with manufacturing sites in Taipei and Kaohsiung and a GMP facility under construction in Zhubei. The company is actively pursuing regulatory approvals and market entry in the US, Japan, and Singapore, aiming for international expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain, focusing on cell therapy product development, clinical trials, and manufacturing. It also plans to expand into contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) services for CAR-T and gene-modified cells, reducing reliance on external lentivirus suppliers by producing key raw materials in-house.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing CAR-T therapies through clinical trials, developing allogeneic CAR-T platforms for hematologic and solid tumors, and optimizing lentivirus production to reduce costs. The company emphasizes technology autonomy, multi-chain CAR designs for solid tumors, and establishing GMP manufacturing capabilities. It also invests in peptide drug development for autoimmune diseases and plans international regulatory filings.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through contract manufacturing of cell therapy products under Taiwan's Special Medical Techniques regulations, sales of non-cell products like hair growth liquids, and eventually from commercial sales of CAR-T therapies upon regulatory approval. The company also anticipates future income from CDMO services and licensing as products enter international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Novartis with its CAR-T product Kymriah, which is currently the only CAR-T therapy approved and reimbursed in Taiwan. The company positions itself as a local innovator with proprietary multi-chain CAR and allogeneic platforms, aiming to offer cost-effective, faster-to-market alternatives with broader indications and regional manufacturing advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$19.6 million in 2024, with an 8.9% year-over-year increase, but remains unprofitable with a net loss of NT$395 million. It has a growing asset base, including significant investments in GMP manufacturing facilities, and continues to invest heavily in R&D with over NT$266 million spent in 2024. The company is in a growth and development phase, supported by capital raises and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology autonomy with proprietary multi-chain CAR designs that enhance efficacy against solid tumors and improve safety profiles. Its ability to produce high proportions of stem central memory T cells (Tscm) in CAR-T products promises longer-lasting therapeutic effects. Local manufacturing reduces vein-to-vein time and costs, while patented lentivirus production technology ensures supply chain stability. The allogeneic platform aims to provide off-the-shelf therapies with improved accessibility.
